description: Defines the AppSearchItem data class used for representing searchable app metadata in the database, including scoring and locale-based icon retrieval.

classes.name: AppSearchItem
classes.description: Data class representing an app search item with metadata, scoring, and locale-aware icon selection.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the best locale-specific icon for the app based on the provided locale list.

methods.name: toIntArray
methods.description: Converts the matchInfo byte array into an integer array, interpreting every 4 bytes as an integer.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two AppSearchItem instances based on score and lastUpdated timestamp.
